    65	function disableAutomaticFontScaling(Component) {

    67	  Component.defaultProps.allowFontScaling = false;

    74	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar = false } = {}) {
    75	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    76	
    77	  try {
    78	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    79	    StatusBar.setTranslucent(true);
    80	    StatusBar.setBackgroundColor(androidTransparentSystemBarColor, true);
    81	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    82	  } catch {}
    83	
    84	  try {
    85	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
    86	  } catch {}
    87	
    88	  try {
    89	    await NavigationBar.setBackgroundColorAsync(androidSystemNavigationBarColor);
    90	  } catch {}
    91	
    92	  try {
    93	    await NavigationBar.setBorderColorAsync(androidSystemNavigationBarColor);
    94	  } catch {}
    95	
    96	  try {
    97	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
    98	  } catch {}
    99	}
   100	
   101	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
   102	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   103	
   104	  useEffect(() => {
   105	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
   106	
   107	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar });
   108	
   109	    applyTheme();
   110	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
   111	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   112	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   113	      if (state === "active") {
   114	        applyTheme();
   115	      }
   116	    });
   117	    let visibilitySubscription;
   118	
   119	    try {
   120	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   121	        applyTheme,
   122	      );
   123	    } catch {}
   124	
   125	    return () => {
   126	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   127	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   128	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   129	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   130	    };
   131	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   132	
   133	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   134	    return null;
   135	  }
   136	
   137	  return (
   138	    <View
   139	      pointerEvents="none"
   140	      style={{
   141	        position: "absolute",
   142	        left: 0,
   143	        right: 0,
   144	        bottom: 0,
   145	        height: insets.bottom,
   146	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   147	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   148	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   149	        zIndex: 1000001,
   150	        elevation: 1000001,
   151	      }}
   152	    />
   153	  );
   154	}

   156	function AndroidStatusBarTint({ dimmed = false }) {
   157	  const height =
   158	    Platform.OS === "android" && Number.isFinite(StatusBar.currentHeight)
   159	      ? Math.max(0, StatusBar.currentHeight)
   160	      : 0;
   161	
   162	  if (height <= 0) {
   163	    return null;
   164	  }
   165	
   166	  return (
   167	    <View
   168	      pointerEvents="none"
   169	      style={{
   170	        position: "absolute",
   171	        top: 0,
   172	        left: 0,
   173	        right: 0,
   174	        height,
   175	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   176	        zIndex: 1000002,
   177	        elevation: 1000002,
   178	      }}
   179	    >
   180	      {dimmed ? (
   181	        <View
   182	          pointerEvents="none"
   183	          style={{
   184	            position: "absolute",
   185	            top: 0,
   186	            right: 0,
   187	            bottom: 0,
   188	            left: 0,
   189	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   190	          }}
   191	        />
   192	      ) : null}
   193	    </View>
   194	  );
   195	}

   240	function StartupQuestionSplash({ headerScrollY }) {
   241	  const [isDismissed, setIsDismissed] = useState(false);
   242	  const [showQuestionOverlay, setShowQuestionOverlay] = useState(false);
   243	  const questionOverlayOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   244	  const handleSplashComplete = useCallback(() => {
   245	    setIsDismissed(true);
   246	    router.replace("/");
   247	  }, []);
   248	
   249	  useEffect(() => {
   250	    const revealTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   251	      setShowQuestionOverlay(true);
   252	    }, startupSplashQuestionRevealDelay);
   253	
   254	    return () => {
   255	      clearTimeout(revealTimer);
   256	    };
   257	  }, []);
   258	
   259	  useEffect(() => {
   260	    if (!showQuestionOverlay) return;
   261	
   262	    questionOverlayOpacity.setValue(0);
   263	    Animated.timing(questionOverlayOpacity, {
   264	      toValue: 1,
   265	      duration: startupSplashQuestionRevealDuration,
   266	      useNativeDriver: true,
   267	    }).start();
   268	  }, [questionOverlayOpacity, showQuestionOverlay]);
   269	
   270	  if (isDismissed) {
   271	    return null;
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  return (
   275	    <View
   276	      style={{
   277	        position: "absolute",
   278	        top: 0,
   279	        right: 0,
   280	        bottom: 0,
   281	        left: 0,
   282	        zIndex: 2000000,
   283	        elevation: 2000000,
   284	      }}
   285	    >
   286	      <StartupOrangeBackground
   287	        style={{
   288	          position: "absolute",
   289	          top: 0,
   290	          right: 0,
   291	          bottom: 0,
   292	          left: 0,
   293	        }}
   294	      />
   295	      <StartupSplashLogo />
   296	      {showQuestionOverlay ? (
   297	        <Animated.View
   298	          style={{
   299	            position: "absolute",
   300	            top: 0,
   301	            right: 0,
   302	            bottom: 0,
   303	            left: 0,
   304	            zIndex: 1,
   305	            elevation: 1,
   306	            opacity: questionOverlayOpacity,
   307	          }}
   308	        >
   309	          <QuestionOverlay
   310	            headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   311	            onClose={handleSplashComplete}
   312	            presentation="splash"
   313	            visible
   314	          />
   315	        </Animated.View>
   316	      ) : null}
   317	    </View>
   318	  );
   319	}
   320	
   321	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY }) {
   322	  const pathname = usePathname();
   323	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   324	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   325	  const {
   326	    cartOverlayActionRequest,
   327	    isQuestionOverlayVisible,
   328	    isShopOverlayVisible,
   329	  } = useShopCart();
   330	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   331	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   332	
   333	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   334	
   335	  const useOverlayHeader =
   336	    pathname === "/" ||
   337	    pathname === "/products" ||
   338	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   339	    pathname === "/contact";
   340	
   341	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   342	    useOverlayHeader &&
   343	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   344	  const isShopQuestionOverlayVisible =
   345	    pathname === "/shop" && isQuestionOverlayVisible;
   346	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   347	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   348	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   349	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   350	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   351	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) &&
   352	    !isShopQuestionOverlayVisible;
   353	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   354	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   355	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   356	    Platform.OS === "android" &&
   357	    ((pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) ||
   358	      isShopQuestionOverlayVisible);
   359	
   360	  return (
   361	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   362	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   363	        <View
   364	          pointerEvents="none"
   365	          style={{
   366	            position: "absolute",
   367	            top: 0,
   368	            left: 0,
   369	            right: 0,
   370	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   371	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   372	          }}
   373	        >
   374	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   375	        </View>
   376	      ) : null}
   377	
   378	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   379	        <Stack
   380	          screenOptions={{
   381	            headerShown: false,
   382	            animation: "none",
   383	            contentStyle: {
   384	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   385	                ? "transparent"
   386	                : "#FFFCF2",
   387	            },
   388	          }}
   389	        />
   390	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   391	
   392	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   393	        <ScreenFade
   394	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   395	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   396	        />
   397	      ) : null}
   398	
   399	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   400	        <View
   401	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   402	          style={{
   403	            position: "absolute",
   404	            top: 0,
   405	            left: 0,
   406	            right: 0,
   407	            zIndex: 1000000,
   408	            elevation: 1000000,
   409	          }}
   410	        >
   411	          <AppHeader
   412	            dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   413	            scrollY={headerScrollY}
   414	            showHero={false}
   415	          />
   416	        </View>
   417	      ) : null}
   418	
   419	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   420	        <AppHeader
   421	          dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   422	          scrollY={headerScrollY}
   423	        />
   424	      ) : null}
   425	
   426	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   427	        <View
   428	          pointerEvents="none"
   429	          style={{
   430	            position: "absolute",
   431	            top: 0,
   432	            right: 0,
   433	            bottom: 0,
   434	            left: 0,
   435	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   436	            zIndex: 1000001,
   437	            elevation: 1000001,
   438	          }}
   439	        />
   440	      ) : null}
   441	
   442	      <StickyCartButton />
   443	
   444	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   445	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   446	      />
   447	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   448	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   449	        pathname={pathname}
   450	      />
   451	      <StartupQuestionSplash headerScrollY={headerScrollY} />
   452	    </View>
   453	  );
   454	}
   455	
   456	export default function RootLayout() {
   457	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   458	
   459	  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
   460	    "Dream Avenue": require("../assets/fonts/dream_avenue/dream_avenue.ttf"),
   461	    "Great Vibes": require("../assets/fonts/great_vibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf"),
   462	    "TT Fors": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_regular.ttf"),
   463	    "TT Fors Demibold": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_demibold.ttf"),
   464	    "TT Fors Black": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_black.ttf"),
   465	    "TT Fors Light": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_light.ttf"),
   466	  });
   467	
   468	  if (!fontsLoaded) {

    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );
    37	}

    39	export default function HomeScreen() {
    40	  const [imageLayouts, setImageLayouts] = useState({});
    41	  const [paragraphLayouts, setParagraphLayouts] = useState({});
    42	  const {
    43	    compactTopLayout,

    55	    inputRange: [0, passionImageBlendScrollDistance],

    58	  });
    59	  const handleParagraphLayout = useCallback(

    66	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[featureName], nextLayout)) {
    67	            return currentLayouts;
    68	          }

    71	            ...currentLayouts,
    72	            [featureName]: nextLayout,
    73	          };
    74	        });
    75	      },
    76	    []

    78	  const handleImageLayout = useCallback(
    79	    (featureName) =>

   123	            magnifyExitAnchorLayout={paragraphLayouts.passion}

   125	            magnifiedScale={homeFeatureMagnifiedScale}
   126	            scrollY={scrollY}
   127	            style={sharedStyles.featureBlock}
   128	          >
   129	            <View
   130	              onLayout={handleImageLayout("passion")}

   132	                sharedStyles.directionalImageBlendWrap,
   133	                { width: croppedImageWidth, height: croppedImageHeight },

   158	                </View>
   159	              ))}
   160	
   161	              {section.note ? (
   162	                <Text style={productsStyles.includeNote}>{section.note}</Text>
   163	              ) : null}
   164	            </View>
   165	          ))}
   166	        </View>
   167	
   168	        <Pressable
   169	          accessibilityLabel={`Buy ${product.title}`}
   170	          accessibilityRole="button"
   171	          onLayout={onBuyButtonLayout}
   172	          onPress={onBuyPress}
   173	          style={({ pressed }) => [
   174	            productsStyles.buyButton,
   175	            pressed && productsStyles.buyButtonPressed,
   176	          ]}
   177	        >
   178	          <ProductOrangeButtonGradient />
   179	          <Text
   180	            adjustsFontSizeToFit
   181	            allowFontScaling={false}
   182	            minimumFontScale={0.72}
   183	            numberOfLines={1}
   184	            style={productsStyles.buyButtonText}
   185	          >
   186	            {`Buy ${product.title}`}
   187	          </Text>
   188	        </Pressable>
   189	      </View>
   190	    </View>
   191	  );
   192	}
   193	
   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}
   233	
   234	export default function ProductsScreen() {
   235	  const {
   236	    compactTopLayout,
   237	    initialContentOffset,
   238	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
   239	    scrollHandlers,
   240	    scrollY,
   241	  } =
   242	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
   243	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
   244	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
   245	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
   246	  const openProductInShop = (productTitle) => {
   247	    router.push({
   248	      pathname: "/shop",
   249	      params: {
   250	        openProduct: String(Date.now()),
   251	        product: productTitle,
   252	      },
   253	    });
   254	  };
   255	
   256	  return (
   257	    <View style={productsStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   258	      <Animated.ScrollView
   259	        style={productsStyles.scroll}
   260	        contentContainerStyle={[
   261	          productsStyles.scrollContent,
   262	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   263	        ]}
   264	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   265	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   266	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   267	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   268	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   269	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   270	        {...scrollHandlers}
   271	      >
   272	        <View style={productsStyles.main}>
   273	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   274	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   275	            pageTitleStyle={productsStyles.pageTitle}
   276	            scrollY={scrollY}
   277	          />
   278	
   279	          {products.map((product, index) => (
   280	            <Fragment key={product.title}>
   281	              <ProductMagnifySection
   282	                croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   283	                onBuyPress={() => openProductInShop(product.title)}
   284	                product={product}
   285	                scrollY={scrollY}
   286	              />
   287	              {index < products.length - 1 ? <PageDivider /> : null}
   288	            </Fragment>
   289	          ))}
   290	        </View>
   291	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   292	    </View>
   293	  );
   294	}

    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5

FILE: mob/app/contact.js

     1	import { useState } from "react";
     2	import { Alert, Animated, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	import CenterMagnifyView from "../components/CenterMagnifyView";
     5	import HapticPressable from "../components/HapticPressable";
     6	import MainScreenIntroSpacer from "../components/MainScreenIntroSpacer";
     7	import contactStyles from "../styles/contactStyles";
     8	import { sendContactMessage } from "../utils/contactMessages";
     9	import { useMainScreenScrollProps } from "../utils/mainScreenScrollContext";
    10	import { getMainScreenScrollViewProps } from "../utils/platformLayout";
    11	import useMainScreenSwipeNavigation from "../utils/useMainScreenSwipeNavigation";
    12	
    13	export default function ContactScreen() {
    14	  const [name, setName] = useState("");
    15	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    16	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
    17	  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    18	  const [emptyTouchedFieldKeys, setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys] = useState({});
    19	  const [blurredFieldKeys, setBlurredFieldKeys] = useState({});
    20	  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    21	  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState("");
    22	  const {
    23	    compactTopLayout,
    24	    initialContentOffset,
    25	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    26	    scrollHandlers,
    27	    scrollY,
    28	  } =
    29	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    30	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    31	  const trimmedName = name.trim();
    32	  const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    33	  const trimmedMessage = message.trim();
    34	  const isEmailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail);
    35	  const canSubmit =
    36	    trimmedName.length > 0 &&
    37	    isEmailValid &&
    38	    trimmedMessage.length > 0 &&
    39	    !isSending;
    40	
    41	  const contactFieldValues = {
    42	    email,
    43	    message,
    44	    name,
    45	    phone,
    46	  };
    47	  const shouldShowFieldFault = (fieldKey) =>
    48	    Boolean(emptyTouchedFieldKeys[fieldKey]) ||
    49	    (fieldKey === "email" &&
    50	      Boolean(blurredFieldKeys.email) &&
    51	      trimmedEmail.length > 0 &&
    52	      !isEmailValid);
    53	
    54	  const clearFieldFault = (fieldKey) => {
    55	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    56	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    57	        return currentFieldKeys;
    58	      }
    59	
    60	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    61	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    62	      return nextFieldKeys;
    63	    });
    64	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    65	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    66	        return currentFieldKeys;
    67	      }
    68	
    69	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    70	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    71	      return nextFieldKeys;
    72	    });
    73	  };
    74	
    75	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    76	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    77	
    78	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    79	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    80	      [fieldKey]: true,
    81	    }));
    82	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    83	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    84	
    85	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    86	        return {
    87	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    88	          [fieldKey]: true,
    89	        };
    90	      }
    91	
    92	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    93	        return currentFieldKeys;
    94	      }
    95	
    96	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    97	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    98	      return nextFieldKeys;
    99	    });
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   103	    setter(text);
   104	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   105	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   106	        return currentFieldKeys;
   107	      }
   108	
   109	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   110	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   111	      return nextFieldKeys;
   112	    });
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   116	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   117	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   118	      return;
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   125	    if (!canSubmit) {
   126	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   127	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   128	        email: true,
   129	      }));
   130	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   131	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   132	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   133	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   134	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   135	      }));
   136	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   137	      return;
   138	    }
   139	
   140	    setIsSending(true);
   141	    setStatusMessage("");
   142	
   143	    try {
   144	      await sendContactMessage({
   145	        email: trimmedEmail,
   146	        message: trimmedMessage,
   147	        name: trimmedName,
   148	        phone: phone.trim(),
   149	      });
   150	      setName("");
   151	      setEmail("");
   152	      setPhone("");
   153	      setMessage("");
   154	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   155	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   156	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   157	      showContactAlert(
   158	        "Message sent",
   159	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   160	      );
   161	    } catch (error) {
   162	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   163	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   164	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   165	    } finally {
   166	      setIsSending(false);
   167	    }
   168	  };
   169	
   170	  return (
   171	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   172	      <Animated.ScrollView
   173	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   174	        contentContainerStyle={[
   175	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   176	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   177	        ]}
   178	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   179	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   180	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   181	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   182	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   183	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   184	        {...scrollHandlers}
   185	      >
   186	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   187	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   188	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   189	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   190	            scrollY={scrollY}
   191	          />
   192	
   193	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   194	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   195	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   196	              General questions about our products?
   197	            </Text>
   198	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   199	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   200	            </Text>
   201	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   202	
   203	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   204	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   205	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   206	              <TextInput
   207	                style={[
   208	                  contactStyles.input,
   209	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   210	                ]}
   211	                placeholder="Your Name"
   212	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   213	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   214	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   215	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   216	                returnKeyType="next"
   217	                textContentType="name"
   218	                value={name}
   219	              />
   220	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   221	
   222	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   223	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   224	              <TextInput
   225	                style={[
   226	                  contactStyles.input,
   227	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   228	                ]}
   229	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   230	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   231	                keyboardType="email-address"
   232	                autoCapitalize="none"
   233	                autoCorrect={false}
   234	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   235	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   236	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   237	                }
   238	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   239	                returnKeyType="next"
   240	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   241	                value={email}
   242	              />
   243	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   244	
   245	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   246	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   247	              <TextInput
   248	                style={[
   249	                  contactStyles.input,
   250	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   251	                ]}
   252	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   253	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   254	                keyboardType="phone-pad"
   255	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("phone")}
   256	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   257	                  updateContactField("phone", text, setPhone)
   258	                }
   259	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("phone")}
   260	                returnKeyType="next"
   261	                textContentType="telephoneNumber"
   262	                value={phone}
   263	              />
   264	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   265	
   266	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   267	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Your Message</Text>
   268	              <TextInput
   269	                style={[
   270	                  contactStyles.input,
   271	                  contactStyles.messageInput,
   272	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   273	                ]}
   274	                placeholder="Your Message"
   275	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   276	                multiline
   277	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   278	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   279	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   280	                }
   281	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   282	                returnKeyType="default"
   283	                textAlignVertical="top"
   284	                value={message}

   290	                accessibilityRole="button"
   291	                disabled={isSending}
   292	                onPress={handleSubmit}
   293	                style={({ pressed }) => [
   294	                  contactStyles.button,
   295	                  (!canSubmit || pressed) && contactStyles.buttonDimmed,
   296	                ]}
   297	              >
   298	                <Text style={contactStyles.buttonText}>
   299	                  {isSending ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
   300	                </Text>
   301	              </HapticPressable>
   302	              {statusMessage ? (
   303	                <Text style={contactStyles.statusText}>{statusMessage}</Text>
   304	              ) : null}
   305	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   306	          </View>
   307	        </View>
   308	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   309	    </View>
   310	  );
   311	}

   940	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {
   941	  const strokeInset = piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth / 2;
   942	  const strokeColor = muted ? "#888888" : "#111111";
   943	  const isUpTriangle = direction === "up";
   944	  const fillGradientId = isUpTriangle
   945	    ? "piccolaQuantityTriangleTopGradient"
   946	    : "piccolaQuantityTriangleBottomGradient";
   947	  const fillGradientColors = isUpTriangle
   948	    ? topOverlayGradientColors
   949	    : orangeButtonGradientColors;
   950	  const path =
   951	    isUpTriangle
   952	      ? [
   953	          `M ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${strokeInset}`,
   954	          `L ${
   955	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   956	          } ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset}`,
   957	          `L ${strokeInset} ${
   958	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   959	          }`,
   960	          "Z",
   961	        ].join(" ")
   962	      : [
   963	          `M ${strokeInset} ${strokeInset}`,
   964	          `L ${
   965	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   966	          } ${strokeInset}`,
   967	          `L ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${
   968	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   969	          }`,
   970	          "Z",
   971	        ].join(" ");
   972	
   973	  return (
   974	    <Svg
   975	      height="100%"
   976	      style={shopStyles.piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleSvg}
   977	      viewBox={`0 0 ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth} ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}`}
   978	      width="100%"
   979	    >
   980	      <Defs>
   981	        <SvgLinearGradient
   982	          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
   983	          id={fillGradientId}
   984	          x1={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   985	          x2={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   986	          y1={isUpTriangle ? piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight : 0}
   987	          y2={isUpTriangle ? 0 : piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}
   988	        >
   989	          {fillGradientColors.map((color, index) => (
   990	            <Stop
   991	              key={`${fillGradientId}-${color}`}
   992	              offset={`${index * 50}%`}
   993	              stopColor={color}
   994	            />
   995	          ))}
   996	        </SvgLinearGradient>
   997	      </Defs>
   998	      <Path
   999	        d={path}
  1000	        fill={`url(#${fillGradientId})`}
  1001	        opacity={muted ? 0.5 : 1}
  1002	        stroke={strokeColor}
  1003	        strokeLinejoin="round"
  1004	        strokeWidth={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth}
  1005	      />
  1006	    </Svg>
  1007	  );
  1008	}

  2627

  2631	    const horizontalDominanceRatio = 0.4375;

  3941	      }
  3942	    } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {

  8901	              }
  8902	              accessibilityRole="button"
  8903	              onPress={handleShopOverlayStickyLeftPress}

  8905	            >
  8906	            <OptionOneButtonGradient
  8907	              variant={isOrderPlacementConfirmed ? "green" : "orange"}
  8908	            />
  8909	            <View
  8910	              pointerEvents="none"

  8912	            >
  8913	              <View
  8914	                style={[
  8915	                  shopStyles.shopOverlayStickyLeftXStroke,
  8916	                  shopStyles.shopOverlayStickyLeftXStrokeForward,
  8917	                ]}
  8918	              />
  8919	              <View

  8922	                  shopStyles.shopOverlayStickyLeftXStrokeBack,
  8923	                ]}
  8924	              />
  8925	            </View>
  8926	          </Pressable>
  8927	        </View>
  8928	      ) : null}
  8929	    </View>
  8930	  );
  8931	}

    94	function getActivePageFromPath(pathname) {
    95	  if (pathname === "/products") return "products";
    96	  if (pathname === "/aboutus") return "aboutus";
    97	  if (pathname === "/contact") return "contact";

   102	function getNavigationDirection(fromPage, toPage) {
   103	  const fromIndex = navPages.indexOf(fromPage);
   104	  const toIndex = navPages.indexOf(toPage);
   105	
   106	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex === toIndex) return 1;
   107	
   108	  const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   109	
   110	  if (fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0) return 1;
   111	  if (fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex) return -1;
   112	
   113	  return toIndex > fromIndex ? 1 : -1;
   114	}

   583	    directionalArrowBaseSuppression.interpolate({
   584	      inputRange: [0, 1],
   585	      outputRange: [1, 0],
   586	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   587	    })
   588	  );

   590	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   591	    directionalLeftArrowOpacity
   592	  ).interpolate({
   593	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   594	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   595	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   596	  });
   597	  const rightArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   598	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   599	    directionalRightArrowOpacity
   600	  ).interpolate({
   601	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   602	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   603	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   604	  });
   605	
   606	  const heroVerticalFadeTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   607	    inputRange: [0, heroVerticalFadeScrollDistance],
   608	    outputRange: [heroVerticalFadeHeight, -heroVerticalFadeFeatherHeight],
   609	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   610	  });
   611

   615	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({

   617	          outputRange: [0, carouselStickyOffsetY],
   618	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   619	        });

   621	    Platform.OS === "ios"
   622	      ? resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   623	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   624	          outputRange: [0, carouselExpansionHeight],
   625	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   626	        })
   627	      : stickyOffset;
   628	  const carouselInnerTranslateY = carouselExpansionOffsetY;
   629	  const centerShadowOpacity =

   633	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   634	          outputRange: [0, 1],
   635	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   636	        });

   639	    inputRange: [96, 120],

   647	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   648	  });
   649

   660	  });
   661

   665	    indicatorSegmentWidth

FILE: mob/components/PageDivider.js
============================================================

     1	import { Animated } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	import sharedStyles from "../styles/sharedStyles";
     4	
     5	const topDividerFadeScrollDistance = 240;
     6	
     7	export default function PageDivider({
     8	  expandedSpacing = false,
     9	  fadeScrollDistance = topDividerFadeScrollDistance,
    10	  fadeWithScrollY = null,
    11	}) {
    12	  const fadeOpacity = fadeWithScrollY?.interpolate({
    13	    inputRange: [0, fadeScrollDistance],
    14	    outputRange: [1, 0],
    15	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    16	  });
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <Animated.View
    20	      style={[
    21	        sharedStyles.pageDivider,
    22	        expandedSpacing && sharedStyles.expandedPageDivider,
    23	        fadeOpacity && { opacity: fadeOpacity },
    24	      ]}
    25	    />
    26	  );
    27	}

     1	import { LinearGradient } from "expo-linear-gradient";
     2	import { StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	export default function ScreenFade({ showTopFade = true, topOffset = 84 }) {
     5	  return (
     6	    <View pointerEvents="none" style={styles.overlay}>
     7	      {showTopFade ? (
     8	        <LinearGradient
     9	          pointerEvents="none"
    10	          colors={[
    11	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.24)",
    12	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.14)",
    13	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.045)",
    14	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.008)",
    15	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.001)",
    16	            "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0)",
    17	          ]}
    18	          locations={[0, 0.14, 0.32, 0.52, 0.72, 1]}
    19	          style={[styles.topFade, { top: topOffset }]}
    20	        />
    21	      ) : null}
    22	
    23	      <LinearGradient
    24	        pointerEvents="none"
    25	        colors={[
    26	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0)",
    27	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.001)",
    28	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.008)",
    29	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.045)",
    30	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.14)",
    31	          "rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.24)",
    32	        ]}
    33	        locations={[0, 0.28, 0.48, 0.68, 0.86, 1]}
    34	        style={styles.bottomFade}
    35	      />
    36	    </View>
    37	  );
    38	}
    39	
    40	const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    41	  overlay: {
    42	    position: "absolute",
    43	    top: 0,

    45	    right: 0,
    46	    bottom: 0,

    64	  },
    65	});

FILE: mob/utils/headerScrollContext.js
============================================================

     1	import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
     2	
     3	const HeaderScrollContext = createContext(null);
     4	
     5	export function HeaderScrollProvider({ children, scrollY }) {
     6	  return (
     7	    <HeaderScrollContext.Provider value={scrollY}>
     8	      {children}
     9	    </HeaderScrollContext.Provider>
    10	  );
    11	}
    12	
    13	export function useHeaderScrollY() {
    14	  return useContext(HeaderScrollContext);
    15	}

============================================================
FILE: mob/utils/openPaymentLink.js
============================================================

     1	import { Alert, Linking, Platform } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	export async function openPaymentLink(url) {
     4	  if (!url) {
     5	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
     6	      window.alert("No payment link has been added for this product yet.");
     7	      return;
     8	    }
     9	
    10	    Alert.alert("Payment link missing", "No payment link has been added yet.");
    11	    return;
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  try {
    15	    const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(url);
    16	
    17	    if (!canOpen) {
    18	      throw new Error("Cannot open URL");
    19	    }
    20	
    21	    await Linking.openURL(url);
    22	  } catch (error) {
    23	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    24	      window.alert("Unable to open this payment link.");
    25	      return;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    Alert.alert("Unable to open link", "Please try again later.");
    29	  }
    30	}
